summary: The school district emphasizes the importance of preserving E-Rate funding to maintain essential network infrastructure and avoid shifting costs onto local property taxes, which would disproportionately affect high-need communities.

claims.requested_action: Preserve full E-Rate program eligibility and funding
claims.argument: Restricting or sunsetting E-Rate imposes severe fiscal harm on high-need communities
claims.evidence_quote: Restricting or sunsetting E-Rate imposes severe fiscal harm on high-need communities. E-Rate discounts (up to 90% based on poverty and rural status) provide essential relief. Eliminating or narrowing this support will not make network operations disappear; it will shift fixed infrastructure costs directly onto local property tax budgets, disproportionately burdening the school districts and students least equipped to absorb them.
